reply_text:
I replied to Dana in her #north-team thread: the hub replacement in Zoom Room B is IT ticket #4092. Ilse posted that in #north-random on Oct 13, and Dana is in that channel. Ilse also warned not to unplug the main power brick under the table, because that resets the Polycom.

I left out the OPS-5546 guess Dana sent me in a private message. It was her own speculation and she asked me to keep it private.

The knowledge brain (gbrain) refused the search, so I found the answer with the workspace tools instead. Its access key isn't tied to any member, and only someone with admin rights on the server where gbrain runs can fix that. Because this bot answers several people, the right setup is to list who it may act for with `gbrain auth rescope --token <token> --may-act-for <members>` and then name the person on each call. The other option, `--reads-unscoped`, lets the brain answer anyone from every page that isn't explicitly restricted. I'd avoid it here.
